_comment: Curated watch list. Every id below was VERIFIED against the live RSS feed on 2026-09-04, not looked up and trusted. lane drives how a video is judged - see YT-WATCH-SPEC.md.

channels.name: Alex Ziskind
channels.why: DGX Spark, local LLM serving, multi-box benchmarking. Published 'DGX Spark cluster' 2026-08-29 - the exact topic we spent S98 on.

channels.name: Manolo Remiddi
channels.why: Home AI lab builds, local-first model serving, cost/benefit of local vs frontier. Directly relevant to the Step 4/5 pooled-model decision.
channels.trap: The handle has a DOT. @manoloremiddi (no dot) is a DIFFERENT person - a personal channel dormant since 2013, 'Shaving my head - Becoming a monk'. A name match is not an identity match; that wrong channel was resolved, inspected, and rejected before this entry was written.

channels.name: AI News & Strategy Daily | Nate B Jones
channels.why: Daily AI news and strategy. Buddy subscribes.
channels.note: Publishes near-daily. Highest noise risk of the four - see the news-lane rule in the spec.

channels.name: Paul J Lipsky
channels.why: AI tooling and news, incl. coverage of the Claude/Cowork product space. Buddy subscribes.
